div.head: VIII Atr 5.2
div.ab: A sceal mid rihte dom æfter dæde ⁊ medmung be mǽþe.
A sceal mid rihte dom æfter dæde ⁊ medemung be mæðe.
A sceal mid rihte dom æfter dæde ⁊ medmung be mǽþe.
A sceal mid rihte dom æfter dæde and medmung be mæþe.
Immer soll von Rechtswegen das Urtheil nach der That und die Abmessung [der Busse] nach dem Range [der Kirche erfolgen].
Judgment must always rightly follow the deed, and assessment [of compensation] the rank [of the church].
Judgment, following the principles of justice, shall always be in accordance with the nature of the deed, and the penalty shall be proportionate to the offence.
Ever by rights must judgment accord with the deed, and the amount of the fine with the status [of the church].
In accordance with justice, judgment must always reflect the nature of the deed and punishment the seriousness of the crime.
div.note: In G, ‘⁊ [on?] Norðhymbra lage’ follows, barely legible. G ends here.; AT: corrected against Whitelock p. 455, October 2026 (was “mœ”, now “mœþ”)

note.seg: kaum lesbar. Es folgt ⁊ [on?] Norðhymbra lage; vgl. Selborne Ancient facts conc. tithes 393.
barely legible. There follows ⁊ [on?] Norðhymbra lage; cf. Selborne Ancient facts conc. tithes 393.
Wiederholt Had 10; vgl. u. 27, 1; Gl Strafe 11a. 13
Repeated in Had 10; cf. below 27, 1; Gl Strafe 11a. 13
Ellipse des Infinitivs; s. d. Wb 3; vgl. Toller 845b III 2
Ellipsis of the infinitive; see that word in Wb 3; cf. Toller 845b III 2

Cf. Had. 10 Liebermann takes this clause as referring particularly to what precedes, i.e. the judgment shall be according to the deed, and the penalty according to the grade of the church, but its verbal agreement with VI, 53 suggests that it may be a general reflection.

note.label: mǽþe
note.seg: At this point the extract in G ends.

note.label: church]
note.seg: Agreeing with Liebermann that in this context mæþ has the same sense as in the previous clauses, the status of the church, and is not in its vaguer sense of “moderation, due measure”. But cf. Hadbot (No. 53 (e)), 10.
